
{{alias}}( arrays )
    Takes elements from one of two one-dimensional ndarrays depending on a
    condition.

    Parameters
    ----------
    arrays: ArrayLikeObject<ndarray>
        Array-like object containing the following ndarrays:

        - one-dimensional condition ndarray.
        - first one-dimensional input ndarray.
        - second one-dimensional input ndarray.
        - a one-dimensional output ndarray.

    Returns
    -------
    out: ndarray
        Output ndarray.

    Examples
    --------
    > var cbuf = [ 1, 0, 1, 0 ];
    > var c = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/vector/ctor}}( cbuf, 'generic' );
    > var xbuf = [ 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0 ];
    > var x = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/vector/ctor}}( xbuf, 'generic' );
    > var ybuf = [ 5.0, 6.0, 7.0, 8.0 ];
    > var y = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/vector/ctor}}( ybuf, 'generic' );
    > var obuf = [ 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 ];
    > var out = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/vector/ctor}}( obuf, 'generic' );
    > {{alias}}( [ c, x, y, out ] )
    <ndarray>[ 1.0, 6.0, 3.0, 8.0 ]

    See Also
    --------
